scope: Corollary 1.2 (Exact weak-recovery threshold for three communities) of the manuscript “The exact reconstruction threshold for the three-state symmetric channel” (preprints/The-exact-reconstruction-threshold-for-the-three-state-symmetric-channel-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 229 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e87d0854f29320d5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the model above, the following statements hold. (i) If (a − b)2 ≤ 3(a + 2b), then every sequence of estimators b σn using only Gn and independent randomization satisfies lim n→∞ E ov(σ, b σn) = 1 3 . (ii) If (a − b)2 > 3(a + 2b), there are ε > 0 and an algorithm, allowed to depend on the fixed parameters a, b, which runs in O(n log n) time and satisfies P  ov(σ, b σn) ≥ 1 3 + ε  −→ 1. Thus weak recovery is possible exactly under the strict inequality, and is information-theoretically impossible at equality.
